title: perfect for my use
text: perfect for my use. I ordered these to organize my travel items.  They are the perfect size to stack.  They are not terribly large, which is good for my purpose and encourages me to choose wisely the items I store. You could put an average size pair of shoes in one  The lid is a "flap" style and does NOT seal air tight.  In fact, it is a very loose seal that barely latches, but for my use that is fine.  The did have a a "plasticky" smell but that reduced fairly quickly. Hope that helps!

product_metadata.title: Sterilite Multipurpose Plastic Flip Top Latching Storage Box Containers with Secure Lid for Home Organization, Clear (36 Pack)
features: STORAGE BOX: 36 pack of organizing bins are ideal for storing accessories, photos, school or office supplies, and more
SEE-THROUGH DESIGN: Clear base and lid provides you easy access and quick identifications of the contents inside
SECURE LID: Equipped with a secure lid that keeps your valuables undamaged and has a hinged latch for ultimate security
VERSATILE USE: Use the containers to declutter your kitchen, bedroom, garage, playroom, or office spaces
SPECIFICATIONS: Made of heavy-duty plastic for long-lasting use; Dimensions (L x W x H): 7 x 6.5 x 4.5 inches
description: The key to a happy life is keeping your ducks (or anything else) in order. Stay organized with the 36 Pack of Sterilite Clear Storage Box Containers. Sterilite FlipTop boxes are a practical solution for reducing clutter and keeping smaller items contained. Enhanced hinged lids ensure the cover will never be misplaced and allow it to remain tightly closed during transport. Modular in design, FlipTop Storage boxes securely stack individually and are interchangeable with the Large FlipTop Storage Box. Ideal for organizing accessories, crafts, photos, CDs, and more in and around the home. FlipTops Storage Boxes are a modular system of containers featuring hinged lids and secure latches. The attached lids allow for easy access to contents and will not get misplaced when opened. A clean home equals a clean life. Whether it's your kitchen, garage, or office, keep your life in order with the Clear Storage Box Containers from Sterilite.
